paper_title: Can 1B LLM Surpass 405B LLM Rethinking Compute-Optimal Test-Time   Scaling
caption: Comparison between the performance of smaller LLMs compute-optimal TTS and that of larger LLMs CoT on MATH-500 and AIME24. (a) & (d) Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct surpasses Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct and GPT-4o on MATH-500 and AIME24; (b) & (e) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B outperforms o1-preview on MATH-500 and AIME24, and surpasses o1-mini on MATH-500; (c) & (f) DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B beats o1 on MATH-500 and AIME24, and exceeds DeepSeek-R1 on AIME24.
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates a comparison of performance scores across several large language models (LLMs) on two datasets, MATH-500 and AIME24, presented in six groups. The horizontal axis represents LLM model names, including “3B unk”, “405B”, “1.5B”, “unk”, “671B”, “7B,” “Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct”, “Llama-3.1-405B-Instruct,” “GPT-4o”, “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B”, “o1-preview”, and “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-7B”, with a consistent ordering within each of the six groups. The vertical axis is labeled with a numeric scale from 0 to 100, incrementing by 10, representing the performance score. Each group displays a set of stacked bars representing the contributions of separate components to the overall score, each identified by a distinct color and a corresponding label: blue for “TTS”, gray for "CoT", pink for “Llama-3.2-3B-Instruct”, purple for “GPT-4o”, light red for “DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B”, and teal for “o1-mini”, "ol-preview", or "ol". Within each group, the bars for the various components are stacked vertically, with the lowest component forming the base of each stack; for example, in group (a), the "TTS" component, depicted in blue, has an approximate value of 78.2, while the "CoT" component represented in gray has a value of 95. The bars are sorted alphabetically within each group, and visual emphasis is applied to certain bars denoted by a small icon, such as a circle, triangle, or square, though these icons do not appear to correlate with height differences. The shortest bar across all groups has a value around 9.3, while the tallest approximately reaches 100.
